verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Lever's Automation Hub handling routine candidate tasks (archiving, tagging, emailing, advancing), SMS scheduling, and repeatable dashboards. None of it documents a way to define a recurring, time-based schedule for jobs or workflows. Routine-task automation and one-off message scheduling are adjacent features, not recurring job scheduling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
